notes: Surrender: ends the match as a loss, but in ranked you keep the points you earned for kills, captures and buildings, minus the normal loss for your rank
Tactical and SEAD missiles store up to 3 shots: fire them back to back, then they reload one at a time
Army limit raised from 150 to 200 units
Unit labels: when the camera is near your units, each shows its type, health and veteran stars (can be turned off in Settings)
Thunder now rolls and cracks instead of sounding like a bomb
Smoother smoke: smoke pushed by a blast drifts and fades out smoothly instead of breaking into black specks or vanishing
Blast physics: explosions throw smoke and dust outward, punch holes through rain, snow and fog, bend trees, kick up rubble, flip wrecks and throw soldiers
Big blasts in bad weather clear a pocket for a while: units inside it spot enemies at their full range until the weather rolls back in
Heavy fog now rolls across the ground as drifting mist
